verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Figma supports exporting assets like SVGs (e.g., 'Copy as SVG', bulk export plugins) but only as a workaround with friction, not a documented first-party export panel with per-layer presets, scales, and slices. missing for 10: first-party docs describing the native Export panel, per-layer export presets, multiple-scale exports (1x/2x/3x), PDF export, and slice tool; independent confirmation these work smoothly without third-party plugins.
